digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, PlanContext assembly and verdict finalization
propositions: Bare `except Exception` in `_assemble_context_uncached` silently swallows `list_tickets` and per-child `show_ticket` failures, leaving `children` empty without recording incompleteness.
Empty `children` list causes `PlanContext.has_children` to return `False`, triggering container-scoped DET checks like `p5_task_dag` to return trivial PASS instead of incompleteness signals.
A total hierarchy-load failure can reach an unqualified clean PASS, violating parent epic AC #4 requiring INDETERMINATE when hierarchy context is incomplete.

`finalize_verdict` uses `coverage` dict (not `PlanContext` attributes) to signal `llm_unavailable` and `verify_failed`, but lacks a channel for `hierarchy_incomplete`; five call sites exist across `workflow_ops.py` and `gate_dispatch.py`, only two in the original plan.
Drift-floor verdict recalculation (`_recompute_verdict_after_drop`) can revert INDETERMINATE back to PASS when a BLOCK is dropped, unless it also checks `hierarchy_incomplete` flag.

Four `plan_review_coach` steps in the YAML gate lack `hierarchy_incomplete` and `hierarchy_incomplete_detail` in their `with:` blocks, causing `ctx.inputs.get(...)` to always default to `False`/`[]` and silent defeat of flag threading to the coach-path `finalize_verdict` call.
